Title: Cross-tenant management is now supported in Azure Security Center

Body.Content: Security Center now supports cross-tenant management scenarios as part of Azure Lighthouse. This enables you to gain visibility and manage the security posture of multiple tenants in Security Center. For more information, see Cross-tenant management experiences.
